* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC errata of 12 December 2022; card image marked E1 published 12 December 2022<ref name="img-e1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-e1">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f434d313352448d45db14e080230103c086b1276 swccg-card-json commit f434d31335] (12 December 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Light: While you control, opponent occupies with an admiral, or Lothal converted, gains one [Light Side] icon. Dark: While you occupy with an admiral, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” No [Light Side] icon printed. '''What changed:''' Both halves were rewritten. Dark: the drain bonus at related sites was replaced by “While you occupy with an admiral, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” Light: the Ghost/Phantom drain text was replaced by “While you control, opponent occupies with an admiral, or Lothal converted, gains one [Light Side] icon.” The printed [Light Side] icon was removed (1 → 0); the card gained the E1 mark.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Lothal (Dark) (Errata 2)]]): PC errata of March 2023: Virtual Set 19 sheet “Updated March 2023” (slip labelled “•Lothal (DARK)”, marked E2)<ref name="sheet19-2023">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-19.pdf Virtual Set 19 sheet] (“SWCCG Players Committee, Updated March 2023”, PDF created 3 March 2023), page 3.</ref> and card image published 6 March 2023<ref name="img-e2">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif</code> as published 6 March 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee51d903e4112d49271f710a330ca82d9168b7c5/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif holotable commit ee51d90] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-e2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/6e6f7f712de07a2c02ddc5073e1b1bcc733f61be swccg-card-json commit 6e6f7f712d] (5 March 2023): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Light: While you occupy, gains one [Light Side] icon. Unless Ghost or Phantom piloted here, Force drain -1 here. Dark: While you occupy, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” One [Light Side] icon. '''What changed:''' Dark: “with an admiral” was dropped (“While you occupy, gains one [Dark Side] icon.”). Light: rewritten to “While you occupy, gains one [Light Side] icon. Unless Ghost or Phantom piloted here, Force drain -1 here.” The printed [Light Side] icon came back (0 → 1); the mark changed to E2.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Lothal (Dark) (Errata 3)]]): PC errata of 30 December 2024; card image marked E3 published 30 December 2024<ref name="img-e3">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-e3">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/38d9f6686457284d0381b644d39a771467537a0c swccg-card-json commit 38d9f66864] (13 January 2025): dating evidence only.</ref>, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set19Type.html Virtual Set 19 card list]: “Light: Piloted Rebel starships here are power and forfeit +1 and immune to Gravity Shadow. Dark: While you occupy, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024) quotes the E2, E1 and original texts. '''What changed:''' Light only: “While you occupy, gains one [Light Side] icon. Unless Ghost or Phantom piloted here, Force drain -1 here.” was replaced by “Piloted Rebel starships here are power and forfeit +1 and immune to Gravity Shadow.” Dark unchanged; still one [Light Side] icon; the mark changed to E3.
